<OPTIONS>
/JSL=Y
/OUTLOOK=N
/PROMPT-TEXT=Step 3. Create a JMP Program
/INSTANCE=10105
</OPTIONS>
/*------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
|
| Load file to a JMP Table table
|
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
If (IsEmpty(::Default_Dir),::Default_Dir ="$default$dir$");
::MyInFile1= ::Default_Dir || "atrms.csv";
Try(Close( Data Table ("atrms_csv") , NoSave);,Print("Warning Only: Table could not be found!"));

::myspfcsv= Open(::MyInFile1,
Import Settings(
   End Of Line( CRLF, CR, LF ),
   End Of Field( Comma ),
   Strip Quotes( 1 ),
   Use Apostrophe as Quotation Mark( 0 ),
   Labels( 1 ),
   Column Names Start( 1 ),
   Data Starts( 2 ),
   Lines To Read( All ),
   Year Rule( "10-90" )
   ));
Wait(0.1);
/*Set Columns Lowercase*/
For(j = 1, j <= NCol(myspfcsv), j++,
  col = Column(j); nm = lowercase(char(column name(j)));
  col << Set Name(nm);
);
::myspfcsv << Set Name("atrms_csv");

// Create the original data table
dt=current data table ();
dt<<select where (is missing (:link));
dt<<delete rows;
dt<<select where (is missing (:parameter_value));
dt<<delete rows;

:operation << Data Type( "Character" );
dt<<new column ("pcg_op", character, formula (:pcg || "_" || :operation));

dt2=dt<< Summary(Group( :pcg_op, :recipe_version, :site ),output table ("summary"));


//SPLIT

// Get unique sites for column headers
site_values = Column(dt2, "site") << Get Values;
site_list = {};
For(i = 1, i <= N Items(site_values), i++,
    If(Contains(site_list, site_values[i]) == 0,
        Insert Into(site_list, site_values[i])
    )
);
site_list = Sort List(site_list);

// Get unique PCGs
pcg_values = Column(dt2, "pcg_op") << Get Values;
pcg_list = {};
For(i = 1, i <= N Items(pcg_values), i++,
    If(Contains(pcg_list, pcg_values[i]) == 0,
        Insert Into(pcg_list, pcg_values[i])
    )
);
pcg_list = Sort List(pcg_list);

// Create new table with PCG column and site columns
dt_result = New Table("Transformed Data",
    Add Rows(N Items(pcg_list)),
    New Column("pcg", Character, "Nominal", Set Values(pcg_list))
);

// Add columns for each site
For(i = 1, i <= N Items(site_list), i++,
    dt_result << New Column(site_list[i], Character, "Nominal")
);

// Get column references for original data
pcg_col = Column(dt2, "pcg_op");
recipe_col = Column(dt2, "recipe_version");
site_col = Column(dt2, "site");

// Fill in the data
For(pcg_idx = 1, pcg_idx <= N Items(pcg_list), pcg_idx++,
    current_pcg = pcg_list[pcg_idx];
    
    // For each site column
    For(site_idx = 1, site_idx <= N Items(site_list), site_idx++,
        current_site = site_list[site_idx];
        
        // Find all recipe_versions for this PCG and site combination
        recipe_versions = {};
        
        For(row = 1, row <= N Rows(dt2), row++,
            If(
                pcg_col[row] == current_pcg & site_col[row] == current_site,
                Insert Into(recipe_versions, recipe_col[row])
            )
        );
        
        // Remove duplicates and sort
        If(N Items(recipe_versions) > 0,
            unique_versions = {};
            For(j = 1, j <= N Items(recipe_versions), j++,
                If(Contains(unique_versions, recipe_versions[j]) == 0,
                    Insert Into(unique_versions, recipe_versions[j])
                )
            );
            unique_versions = Sort List(unique_versions);
            
            // Convert to comma-separated string
            version_string = Char(unique_versions[1]);
            For(j = 2, j <= N Items(unique_versions), j++,
                version_string = version_string || "," || Char(unique_versions[j])
            );
            
            // Set the value in the result table
            result_col = Column(dt_result, current_site);
            result_col[pcg_idx] = version_string;
        );
    );
);

// Show the result
dt_result << Bring Window to Front;


//NEW FLAG


// Get reference to the current data table
dt_result = Current Data Table();

// Get all column names that start with "A"
all_cols = dt_result << Get Column Names(string);
a_cols = {};
For(i = 1, i <= N Items(all_cols), i++,
    If(Left(all_cols[i], 1) == "A",
        Insert Into(a_cols, all_cols[i])
    )
);

// Create the new column
dt_result << New Column("New_Flag", Numeric, Continuous, Formula(

Local({values = {}, non_missing_count = 0},
        
    // Collect all non-missing values from A% columns
    For(i = 1, i <= N Items(a_cols), i++,
        Local({col_name = a_cols[i]},
            If(!Is Missing(Column(col_name)[Row()]),
                Insert Into(values, Column(col_name)[Row()]);
                non_missing_count++;
            )
        )
    );
        
    // Check conditions
    If(non_missing_count == 0, 0, // No values at all
        If(non_missing_count == 1 & Contains(Char(values[1]), ","), 1, // Condition 1: Only 1 column has value and contains comma
            If(non_missing_count > 1, // Condition 2: Multiple values - check if they are different
                Local({first_value = values[1], all_same = 1},
                    For(j = 2, j <= N Items(values), j++,
                        If(values[j] != first_value,
                            all_same = 0;
                            Break()
                        )
                    );
                    If(all_same == 0, 1, 0) // If values are different, flag = 1, else 0
                ),
                0 // Default case
            )
        )
    )
)
));








dt4=dt_result << Summary(Sum( :New_Flag ),Freq( "None" ),Weight( "None" ),output table ("dd"));
Column(dt4, "N Rows") << Set Name("Total_PCG");
Column(dt4, "Sum(New_Flag)") << Set Name("Total_Flag");
dt4 << New Column("CE%", Numeric, Continuous, Format("Percent", 12, 2), Formula(1 - (:Total_Flag / :Total_PCG)));


dt_result<<select where (:New_Flag==0);
dt_result<<delete rows;
dt_result<<new column ("operation", character, set each value (Right(:pcg, 4)));;
dt_result<<new column ("PCG", character, set each value(Substitute(:pcg, "_1204", "")));
dt_result<<delete columns ("pcg");
dt_result << Move Selected Columns( {"operation", "PCG"}, To First );
